title: Maiora M|30 Superyacht Premieres At Cannes Yachting Festival
description: Maiora unveils the first Maiora M|30 at Cannes Yachting Festival 2026, with four hulls already sold before the official premiere.
html:
Italian Shipyard Launches First Unit Of New 30.4-Metre Motor Superyacht Line

Maiora, one of NEXT Yacht Group's flagship brands, is set to make waves at the Cannes Yachting Festival 2026 with the official public premiere of the first Maiora M|30. The Italian shipyard's latest addition to its motor superyacht portfolio represents a significant evolution in design philosophy, combining enhanced guest accommodations with seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces that define modern luxury cruising. The first hull was officially launched at Maiora's facility in Viareggio, attended by the owner and his family in a private ceremony that marked the beginning of what the yard anticipates will be a highly successful production run. The market response has already validated the design vision: four additional Maiora M|30 hulls have been sold even before the vessel's public debut, a testament to the model's appeal among discerning charter and private ownership markets.

The Maiora M|30 builds upon the proven success of the earlier Maiora 30 model while introducing a refreshed exterior profile, expanded guest areas, and improved flow between exterior and interior spaces. The exterior design, crafted by Quartostile studio, features a distinctive high bow and raised pilot house that liberates the entire main deck for entertaining and relaxation. The interiors were developed by Acube in close collaboration with Maiora Style Centre, emphasizing the yard's commitment to bespoke customization and refined aesthetics. Accommodation for twelve guests is distributed across five cabins, with the full-beam master suite occupying the bow section of the main deck. Four additional cabins below deck include two VIP suites, while three crew cabins forward provide comfortable quarters for a crew of five. The vessel's generous lateral glazing is a signature feature of the line, flooding interiors with natural light and creating visual continuity with the surrounding seascape.

The Maiora M|30 prioritizes al fresco living and entertainment throughout its layout. The cockpit seamlessly integrates with the beach club to form an expansive lounging area, while the flybridge features a second helm station and ample space for dining, socializing, and sunbathing both forward and aft. The main deck saloon, divided into distinct dining and lounge zones, serves as the primary indoor social space, separated from the owner's suite by a lobby and galley. The vessel's internal volume reaches 190 GT, providing substantial space for both crew operations and guest comfort. Powered by twin 2,000 hp MAN V12-2000 engines, the Maiora M|30 achieves a top speed of 21 knots while maintaining the fuel efficiency and reliability expected in the superyacht segment. The GRP hull measures 30.4 meters in length with a 7.5-meter beam and 2.1-meter draft, proportions optimized for both performance and seaworthiness.

Key Specifications:

• Length: 30.4 meters

• Beam: 7.5 meters

• Draft: 2.1 meters

• Guest Capacity: 12 across 5 cabins

• Crew: 5 in dedicated cabins

• Engines: Twin MAN V12-2000 (2,000 hp each)

• Top Speed: 21 knots

• Internal Volume: 190 GT Main Characteristics:

• Full-beam master suite on main deck bow

• Four additional cabins below deck with two VIP suites

• Signature lateral glazing throughout interiors

• Integrated cockpit and beach club lounging area

• Flybridge with second helm station and entertainment zones

• GRP hull construction for durability and performance

The Maiora M|30's official debut is scheduled for September 8-13, 2026, at the Cannes Yachting Festival, where the first unit will be showcased alongside other NEXT Yacht Group offerings. For charter operators and private owners seeking a modern superyacht that balances performance, accommodation, and sophisticated design, the Maiora M|30 represents a compelling proposition in the 30-meter segment.
